title_sq: Apartament 2+1+Garazhd ne shitje tek Kopshti Botanik prane Xhamise se Selites ne Tirane (ID 41211394)
description_sq:
Tek “Kopshti Botanik”,prane Xhamise shitet apartament 2+1, me siperfaqe 116 m² ,ne katin e 4 te nje ndertimi te ri. Apartamenti organizohet ne nje ambjent ndenje bashke me kendin e gatimit, 2 dhoma gjumi,2 tualete,2 ballkone. Eshte totalisht i investuar dhe mobiluar ne menyre moderne,me punime cilesore. Ka kubature te rregullt dhe orjentim jug-lindje.Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor , ne cmim gjithashtu perfshihet edhe nje post parkimi prej 12 m².
Cmimi i shitjes eshte 280 000 Euro.
title_en: Apartment 2+1+Garage for sale at the Botanical Garden near Selite Mosque in Tirana (ID 41211394)
description_en: At the "Botanic Garden", near Xhamisa, a 2+1 apartment is for sale, with an area of ​​116 m², on the 4th floor of a new building. The apartment is organized in a living room with a kitchenette, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 2 balconies. It is fully invested and furnished in a modern way, with quality works. It has regular cubature and south-east orientation. It has regular mortgage documentation, the price also includes a parking space of 12 m². The selling price is 280,000 Euros.
